title: Ram Ramirez, songwriter and pianist
summary: Humes made a session with Ram Ramirez, who writes beautiful songs, can play when he wants, and is temperamental but nice.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well now, tell me about Ram (Ramirez) because he's another pianist. You did a record session with him.
Well you like those songs he wrote.
Oh he wrote some beautiful songs. Now he can play when he wants to.
Yeah, well he's another funny man. He's a little temperamental, isn't he?
He's got a funny outlook on life or something. But he's a nice guy.
Oh yes he is. He's a very nice guy.
He talked to me about you. He told me some very appreciative things about you.
Yeah. Well, he's a great pianist.
Yeah he is, and of course, he sort of made a place for himself now as a, well as almost a cocktail pianist I suppose in a way. Not really but with his own little group or something.

Yeah, well I don't know no little group he's got.
Well he works in New York, maybe he worked as a single.
